value.dispatchSummary: Dispatches a no-commit, read-only R65C worker decision pass to classify public-sync publish-or-hold posture after R65A/R65B and decide whether provider receipt-link integrity checker implementation deserves a later packet.
value.publicSyncStatusAtDispatch: clean; main...origin/main [ahead 2]; public push not authorized
value.nextAllowedMove: Execute no-commit MSEA-R65C worker decision pass only. Worker may create only the R65C decision matrix and worker return in provenance, may read public-sync status/remote/log/matrix/audit evidence, and must not mutate, commit, or push public-sync.
value.claimBoundary: R65C dispatch authorizes only decision-only read work. It does not authorize public-sync mutation, public commit, public push, checker implementation, runtime/source/test edits, provider/live proof, JSON receipt export, OpenAI certification uplift, production Memory/RAG release, retrieval/vectorization, P3 reopen, use-case/legal workflow, hosted/public/production claim, worker commit, historical rename/move sweep, or downstream release.
